sql.query: SELECT w.id,w.rowVersion,w.modifiedDate,w.modifiedByUserId,COALESCE(u.displayName,'Unknown user') AS modifiedByUserName FROM tbl_workflows w LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=w.modifiedByUserId WHERE w.id=:id AND w.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants membership WHERE membership.userId=:userId AND membership.tenantId=w.tenantId AND membership.isActive=1 AND membership.membershipStatus='active') LIMIT 1
